correctness.rationale: Choosing the original pair of positions is in bijection with gap-based insertion vectors producing a given output, including repetitions. An output with at least two positions outside the joint center alphabet can have at most two usable positions, which cannot realize both distinct centers, so an alphabet of size q contributes exactly C_p+(q-s)E_p. Of the 15 partitions of four positions, two give identical centers, leaving 13 patterns, independently recomputed. Four patterns have (s,C,E)=(2,11,8) and all other admissible expressions are 8q-6, 4q or 6, strictly smaller than 8q-5. The four patterns are precisely one constant word and one mixed word with one letter in common, in either order, hence 2q(q-1) unordered labeled pairs. Any shared output multiset can be realized with distinct vectors up to each minimum multiplicity, so the maximum plus one is the exact threshold.
